```sql
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM customers c
  JOIN (
        SELECT o.customer_id,
               sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
               count(*)           AS order_count,
               max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
          FROM orders o
         WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
           AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT ci.id
                                   FROM customers ci
                                  WHERE ci.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s)
         GROUP BY o.customer_id
        HAVING count(*) = count(o.created_at)
           AND max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
           AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
       ) t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De originele `MATERIALIZED` CTE las en sorteerde alle orders van alle tenants. Deze versie aggregeert alleen de orders van klanten binnen de tenant, in één enkele pass, en vervangt de `DISTINCT ON` door `max()`. Omdat `created_at DESC` NULL vooraan sorteert, sluit de `HAVING count(*) = count(created_at)`-check klanten met een NULL-datum uit, net als het origineel.
